<div class="card-body">
'''Timer Mine''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手側に配備する。自分の次のターンの始めに“爆発”する。運命数を引く。その場所にいる相手のキャラクターは、出た数の枚数だけ、ロストデッキに送られる（どれを選ぶかは相手の任意）。タイマー地雷もロストデッキ行きとなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-162o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷敷設ドロイドに運搬できるよう設計された時限式爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破に使用されるのが通例だが、軍事用も多数存在する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Timer Mine.

'''Card text:''' Deploy to the opponent's side of a site where you have a mine-laying droid. It explodes at the start of your next turn. Draw destiny. Your opponent chooses that many of their characters there to send to the Lost Pile. Timer Mine is also lost.

'''Lore:''' A time bomb designed for transport by a mine-laying droid. Commonly used to blast ore veins and spice mines, with many military versions as well.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Timer Mine]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
